system.description:
As a Commander, you are the voice that cuts through the clash of steel and the roar of cannon. You might be a decorated officer of the Eisen army, a mercenary captain, or a privateer who’s earned the respect of a crew. What matters is that others follow when you give the order.

STARTING EVASION: 11
STARTING HP: 6

Thematic Items

A bloodstained standard, or a dented officer’s badge

Commander's Hope Feature

Issued Orders. Spend 3 Hope issue orders, making an ally that can hear you gain Advantage on rolls made to carry them out until the scene ends or they fail with Fear.

Archetype Feature

Veteran of Many Fields

Gain a Talent from any non-magical Domain. At level 5, gain an additional Talent from a different non-magical Domain.

Battle Ritual

Once per rest, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do, clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.
backgroundQuestions: Who taught you the art of command, and what did you learn from their greatest failure?
You once led others into a battle they didn’t return from. What happened?
connections: You once served under my command. What did we face, and how did we survive?
What do I always trust you to do?
What lesson did I teach you - intended or not - that you’ve never forgotten?
